fato_historico: 1914: World War I: The German minelayer SS Königin Luise lays a minefield about 40 miles (64 km) off the Thames Estuary (Lowestoft). She is intercepted and sunk by the British light-cruiser HMS Amphion.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a push toward uncharted waters, much like ancient ships navigating unknown tides. It is a good time to consider how your own boundaries can be expanded with grace. Perhaps you are meant to transform challenges into stepping stones, clearing away old obstacles to reveal a brighter path ahead for your adventurous spirit.
frase_do_dia: Adventure awaits those who bravely sail beyond the known horizon of their current limits.
significado_numero: The master builder number representing deep wisdom and practical manifestion.
conselho: Trust your intuition when navigating complex situations today; let your inner compass lead.
